name: Havells India Ltd

ledger.quote: We have been working closely with our channel to increase consumer offtake, and we believe that the channel inventories will normalize by the end of Q3.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.target: Normalize channel inventories by end of Q3
ledger.verdict: Management did not discuss Q3 FY26 channel inventory normalization on the call.

ledger.quote: FY 25-26 will be about INR1,450 crores. FY 26-27, right now, it's estimated about INR1,000 crores, but we'll know the exact numbers by end of March.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.target: FY27 capex estimated at INR1,000 crores
ledger.verdict: INR800 crores capex spend commitment for FY27 remains ongoing during the financial year.

ledger.quote: So ECD continuously, there will be aspiration for growth and improvement of margins.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.verdict: Reported financial numbers do not disclose segment-wise ECD margins to verify improvement.

ledger.quote: And going forward also, in the coming year also, we do feel that there is enough opportunity in the solar segment to continue to grow.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.verdict: Renewables and solar segment grew contributions to revenue in Q2 FY27.
ledger.evidence: We are also looking at this business differently. We're not looking at just as a commodity business. We want to build more brand and distribution stickiness to this business.

ledger.quote: So hopefully by the end of this year early next year first quarter we'll be having the entire capacity which was planned.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.verdict: Planned capacity expansion is ongoing with full stream now expected within the next 18 months.
ledger.evidence: I think the expansion is pretty much on track, that's what we had pointed out. And I think by in next 18 months, the full expansion will be on stream.

ledger.quote: Yes I think by '27-'28 major capex would go into cables and wires which is already panned out.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.target: major capex into cables and wires
ledger.verdict: Major capex allocation to cables and wires scheduled for FY27-28 remains ongoing.

ledger.quote: And that will happen over the next two, two and a half years. There is no major new capex in the Lloyd segment.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.target: R&D centre over next two, two and a half years
ledger.by_when: next two, two and a half years
ledger.verdict: R&D centre capex over next two to two and a half years remains ongoing.

ledger.quote: Hopefully, in the next couple of years, we should continue to grow even in the B2C segment, especially where we see a lot of growth opportunity in Lloyd and ECD.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.verdict: Target to continue B2C growth over the next couple of years remains ongoing.

ledger.quote: So we are very confident that Q2 will see a good growth in the international and overall switchgear segment.
ledger.speaker: Rajiv Goel
ledger.verdict: Switchgear segment delivered volume growth closer to double digits in Q2 FY27.
ledger.evidence: I think the markets have settled down now with the price increases, and so second quarter is a regular demand which has come from the market.

ledger.quote: As they grow, we are expecting to grow our contribution and overall profitability much higher than the value growth in sales itself.
ledger.speaker: Rajiv Goel
ledger.verdict: Reported numbers show EBITDA grew 30.8% YoY against revenue growth of 34.6%.
ledger.evidence: Revenue YoY % Sep 2026 34.6%, EBITDA Sep 2025 438.0, EBITDA Sep 2026 573.0

ledger.quote: All this has happened also due to the volatility and timing differences between passing price hikes and all that. But otherwise, in full quarters, we will definitely see it coming back to double digits.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.verdict: OPM came in at 9.0% for Q2 FY27, missing the promised double-digit margin for full quarters.

ledger.quote: So the way we look at it is that Lloyd spends on A&P will remain elevated for the next couple of years because there is a dual requirement of also premiumizing the brand in the product categories
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.target: elevated A&P spends for next couple of years
ledger.verdict: Elevated A&P spend plan for Lloyd over next couple of years remains ongoing.

open.quote: So, I think the expansion is pretty much on track, that's what we had pointed out. And I think by in next 18 months, the full expansion will be on stream.
open.speaker: Rajiv Goel

open.quote: RAC continues to be the large part of the business, close to almost 75%. And hopefully, over a period of time, we want to bring it to around 60% with growth in the non-RAC products.
open.speaker: Rajiv Goel

read: Only three promises have been settled so far (two kept, one missed), which is too little to judge management track record. The next commitments falling due are FY27 capex completion and full-year margin targets.
questions: When will consolidated OPM return to double digits after missing the 10% target in Q2 FY27?
What steps are being taken to resolve raw material cost pressure in Lloyd during the off-season?
Why was the planned capacity expansion timeline extended to the next 18 months?
bull: Revenue grew 34.6% YoY in Sep 2026 to Rs 6,432 crore.
Switchgear segment achieved double-digit volume growth in Q2 FY27.
Debt to equity ratio remains low at 0.02 with borrowings of Rs 239 crore.
bear: OPM missed double-digit expectations, landing at 9.0% in Q2 FY27.
Operating profit growth of 30.8% lagged total revenue growth of 34.6% in Sep 2026.
Planned capacity expansion timeline extends out another 18 months.
